== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Harness is a world characterized by a vast, monster-filled wilderness that is inhabited by various walled cities, such as [[Sarcoline City]]. Unlike other realms, the inhabitants of this world do not utilize [[sacred arts]]; instead, they rely on contracted monsters to perform tasks and exert influence. Because of this reliance on creatures, it is highly uncommon for humans to possess innate abilities. The environment itself is noted for being intensely reactive, and there are concerns that certain threats may eventually exceed the capacity of this world to manage them.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Harness is a wilderness where every living creature is a monster and the inhabitants do not practice the [[sacred arts]]. Within this realm, legends spread from [[Sarcoline City]] to various other walled cities, and the entire world once pushed back against [[Dross]]. The location contains [[Abidan]] files regarding security measures, yet it may be unable to handle threats that exceed its local monsters. Characters are currently attempting to ensure the [[Fate|fate]] of this iteration is not derailed.}}
